attributes.description:
Accessibility:
Free and accessible shuttle buses will service all stations between Broadway & North Quincy. Accessible van service is also available. Riders should see station personnel for assistance.

Alternate Rail service:
Riders are strongly encouraged to use the Fall River/New Bedford, Kingston and Greenbush (Old Colony) Commuter Rail lines for fare-free service between Braintree, Quincy Center, JFK/UMass, and South Station Regular fares should be purchased for travel beyond Braintree.

Travel times:
Riders using shuttle bus service should budget ample extra travel time. For example, a rider traveling to Downtown Crossing from Braintree should budget at least 50 minutes of travel time in addition to their regular commute.

Shuttle Locations:

Broadway:
W. Broadway @ Broadway Station

Andrew:
Northbound - Dorchester Ave @ Leeds St
Southbound - Dorchester Ave @ Dexter St

JFK/UMass:
Northbound - Inner Busway
Southbound - Outer Busway

North Quincy:
All shuttles - North Quincy Busway
attributes.header: Red Line: Shuttle buses will replace service between Broadway and North Quincy from Nov 20 - 22, for switch and rail upgrades. Train service will operate between JFK/UMass & Ashmont. Commuter Rail will be fare-free between Braintree and South Station.

attributes.description:
Train service between Wonderland and Revere Beach will operate on the outbound (Wonderland) track approximately every 14 minutes. At Revere Beach, riders will board at the normal platform locations. Inbound service will continue beyond Revere Beach and operate normally to Bowdoin. 

Wayfinding:
Riders are encouraged to follow directions via station signage and from onsite station personnel. Train predictions via countdown clocks will not be available between Wonderland and Revere Beach.  

Fares:
No fares will be collected at Wonderland. 

Travel Time:
Riders will experience longer wait times and should allow extra travel time during this work.
attributes.header: Blue Line: To accomplish switch work at Wonderland, all trains will be operating on the outbound/eastbound track between Wonderland and Revere Beach the weekend of November 14 - 15.

attributes.description:
Fall/Winter Commuter Rail schedules will take effect on Monday, October 26. Schedules for all lines will be available soon at mbta.com/CR. The Fall/Winter schedule maintains consistent service throughout the day, late at night, and on weekends.

Schedules will not change on the Fall River/New Bedford, Framingham/Worcester, Greenbush, and Kingston Lines.

On the Fitchburg, Haverhill, Lowell, Needham, Newburyport/Rockport, and Providence/Stoughton Lines, several trains will depart earlier or later than in the current schedule to improve resiliency, better reflect operating conditions, and to align with Amtrak schedules.

The Franklin/Foxboro Line will remain on a construction schedule while important track work is completed, and some train departure times have been adjusted.

Train numbers on all lines will also change with the implementation of the Fall/Winter schedule.

Passengers are encouraged to review the new schedules ahead of October 26 to plan their trips.
